svg.title: Phi Phi: six islands, many stories
svg.desc: Accurate coastline outlines from OpenStreetMap show Ko Yung and Bamboo Island north of Phi Phi Don; Phi Phi Leh and the two Bida islands lie to the south. A separate inset labels Maya Bay, Pileh Lagoon, Loh Samah and Viking Cave. North is up. Educational orientation, not a navigation chart.

g.text: The Phi Phi archipelago · Krabi, Thailand
Inset shown at a larger scale
Educational map · North is up · Not for navigation
